svg.aria-label: Currently building Muezza and learning new things along the way. I enjoy dabbling in all kinds of tech. Below, five penguins wander across a snowfield between an iceberg and a glowing igloo, where another reads a book by lamplight, seen only as its shadow on the ice. Far back by the horizon, a penguin has a session on a small halfpipe: it drops in, pumps up speed, turns in the air over the lips, kickflips across the flat and airs back onto the deck for a rest. In front on the right, Pingu in white earmuffs and a light blue scarf rolls a snowman out of a heap of snow, gives it a pink beanie and his little plush snowman to hold and hugs it, while Muezza the cat naps in a bed labeled MUEZZA. Then she wakes, jumps out, pounces on the snowman to play and knocks it back into a heap. In the middle, a penguin in a green bobble hat chips a hole in the ice and fishes; Muezza waits until his catch is in his bucket, sneaks up, steals it and eats it in bed.
